traces.name: Alsóbélatelep
traces.note: Rough western coastal residential-grid extent from the native street/rail map, clipped to the frozen built-area surface. West/upper separation from Bélatelep is approximate; overlapping searches are intentional. Whole built neighbourhood estimate, not a radius.

traces.name: Bélatelep
traces.note: Rough historic western hillside/coastal neighbourhood extent following the actual coastal transport corridor and hill street fabric. The southern/eastern ridge connections are inferred; not a surveyed or formal quarter boundary.

traces.name: Kertváros
traces.note: Approximate garden suburb south/east of the western coastal rail corridor, based on actual local street-grid and built-area edge. Street-block-scale outer connections estimated from map context.

traces.name: Fürdőtelep
traces.note: Rough central holiday neighbourhood around the Ady Endre/coastal rail corridor, using mapped residential streets and the eastern rail/water edge. Internal divisions are map estimates.

traces.name: Sándortelep
traces.note: Approximate north-south built strip around Szent István/Sándor street fabric; Bézsenyi street and water/rail edges guide the outer extent. May overlap the broader holiday-quarter interpretation; not an official subdivision.

traces.name: Fonyódliget
traces.note: Rough eastern lakeside holiday/residential strip along Köztársaság/coastal railway, including the named southern street grid; clipped to built context to avoid treating the large fishing ponds as the neighbourhood. Canal/rail-end links estimated.

traces.name: Templomhegy
traces.note: Rough whole local hill/street quarter northwest of the castle using the native Petőfi/Templom/Ilona street fabric and church-plot context. Outer slopes/road connections are inferred, not a building footprint.

traces.name: Kecskehegy
traces.note: Rough Hősök tere/Kecskeugrató hill-quarter extent, reconstructed from actual roads and the riverbank slope; distinct from a radius around the name point.

traces.name: Várdomb
traces.note: Rough castle hill area including the hilltop and surrounding approach/green space, reconstructed from the native local road map. Extent is larger than a castle building polygon; slope/foot connections estimated.

traces.name: Váralja
traces.note: Rough lower-castle street quarter around Rátkay/Rákóczi/Jókai approaches and the bridge-side foot of the hill. Native street context with estimated closure, may overlap the hillside quarter.

traces.name: Tabán
traces.note: Rough historical Tabán built quarter east of the railway/Ady Endre corridor below Kálvária, using actual Tabán/Öregárok/Alsóburgundia roads. Ridge-side boundary connections estimated.

traces.name: Kálváriahegy
traces.note: Rough Kálvária hill-and-slope quarter, based on native mapped Kálvária/Alsó Kálvária and Burgundia street fabric. Includes more than the chapel/monument footprint; slope connectors inferred.

traces.name: Bölcske utca
traces.note: Rough lower Bölcske-street residential/cellar quarter using mapped Belső/Felső/Alsó Bölcske and Kiskúti/Zrínyi connections, not merely a buffer on one road. Outer hill-block limits are inferred.

traces.name: Érsekkert
traces.note: Approximate whole historical park extent, traced from native service/park paths, Vajas-channel bank and the surrounding Érsekkert/Asztrik street context. No invented residential footprint or palace-only polygon; local parcel edges are estimated.

traces.name: Csajdakert
traces.note: Approximate park/bath complex extent including the native water-park grounds and adjoining green area. Municipal street-bounded park description supports identity; not just a pool/building footprint. South/west parcel connections are estimated.

traces.name: Széchenyi-lakótelep
traces.note: Rough full estate block reconstructed from Széchenyi/Kossuth, Csajda and Kubinszky local road context and the panel-building/service-road fabric. Not a small building footprint; outside block connections are inferred.

traces.name: Zrínyi-lakótelep
traces.note: Approximate estate extent guided by municipal Pataji/Kossuth/Gombolyagi/Zrínyi street description and actual street geometry. Retains all estate-scale blocks rather than one building; precise outer corner/closure connections estimated.

traces.name: Homokgyőr
traces.note: Rough whole rural locality including its farmyard/residential core and adjacent local access-road/field blocks northeast of Gombolyagi street and above the railway. Boundary connections across fields are estimates, not a standalone small farm-building footprint.

traces.name: Vörösszállás
traces.note: Rough isolated rural settlement extent encompassing the mapped built core and its approach/field block, using the named Vörösszállás access road. Field-edge closure is inferred; not a circle or a building footprint.

traces.name: Urbántanya
traces.note: Rough rural locality extent around its native farmyard/access roads on the eastern channel bank, including surrounding homestead land. Boundary links between road/field corners are inferred; not a small building polygon.

traces.name: Árendás-dűlő
traces.note: Rough agricultural/garden locality west of Meszesi/Bátyai, using the actual Árendás/Duna approach-road fabric, northern canal and field-block edges. No official dűlő survey claimed; deliberately broader than the house/street footprint and no radius construction.
